fact: The coordinator of the volunteer expert committee says there are no foreign providers on the maintenance contract for Mali Kura Biométrie, the new RAVEC system launched on 13 February 2024.
The territorial administration minister says Mali Kura Biométrie was designed autonomously by Malian engineers between 2 October and 16 December 2023, replacing the system recovered from IDEMIA.
DNEC says ANSAEC, the national agency, administers the RAVEC database, hosted in a technical room it fitted out to ISO 27001 norms.
The government says the source codes and licences of Mali Kura Biométrie are held by national experts, ending dependence on foreign providers (the French firm Idemia).
